name: AI Usage
subtitle: AI limits and usage widgets
platform: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon
description:
See AI usage on your Mac, right on your desktop. Connect a tool’s local history to see recorded requests, tokens, and estimated API value for today, the last week, or the last month.

Choose the Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity folders you want to include. AI Usage reads them with your permission and shares only summary numbers with its widgets. No dashboard or separate server is required.

See ChatGPT account limits by signing in with OpenAI, or use recent limit readings from a Codex session. Claude Code users can add an optional status-line setting to receive the limit windows Claude reports. Local Antigravity history supplies usage totals.

Add AI plan limits or AI usage totals from the macOS widget gallery. Preview both with fictional data in Demo, or connect your own AI Usage dashboard if you already run one. API value is an estimate, not a bill.

AI Usage is an independent app.
reviewNotes: Open AI Usage from Applications. The Sources window defaults to This Mac. To review without provider accounts or history, select Demo, click Preview widgets, and add AI plan limits and AI usage totals from Edit Widgets on the desktop. Both widgets identify sample data. To test real local history, select This Mac, Connect next to a supported tool, and choose its history folder. The app accesses only directories selected in the system Open panel. ChatGPT sign-in and the optional Claude Code status line supply account limits. Dashboard is an optional connection to a reviewer-provided server. No developer account, remote demo server or hardware is required.
